title: Law to promote voucher homeownership program to tenants
summary: This bill would require the Department of Housing Preservation and Development to run an education and outreach campaign informing Section 8 Housing Choice Voucher participants about the Housing Choice Voucher Homeownership program. The campaign must cover eligibility requirements and application procedures and begin within 90 days of the law taking effect. Materials must be distributed at in-person events and by mail, in English and all citywide designated languages.
